cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a resort cabana with a shaded daybed by the water — chest-deep in the water; a monastery library of tall wooden shelves — sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — sitting on the ground; a present-day immersive planetarium event foyer — testing a small hand-held star projector during an adult celestial-guide costume evening; an outdoor theatre of tiered seats facing a stage — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a Three Kingdoms festival street — standing; a modern flower-lined bicycle promenade beside a canal — taking a break on her own bicycle while watching floating fallen petals; a medieval guild workshop — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — sitting on the ground; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — seated sideways on a stool or bench; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — holds a cup in both hands; the Changban Bridge memorial — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder
